# atlas/ — the agent's read layer

A generated snapshot of the Atlas design system, shaped for agents rather than humans. **Figma is the authority; this is a cache.**

- `index.md` — one line per component. Start here.
- `<Name>.md` — when to use, when not to, do/don't. Read only for components you will use.
- `metadata/<Name>.json` — variants, sizes, props, tokens used, Figma node id.
- `tokens.md` / `tokens.json` — semantic tokens and layout scales only.
- `state/` — `status` (per-component progress), `discrepancies` (Figma↔code drift), `decisions` (already settled — check before asking), `candidates` (gaps prototypes had to hand-roll).

Every file is generated. Do not hand-edit: fix Figma or the generator, then re-run the `atlas-figma-sync` skill.

`syncedAt: null` and `source: "repo-derived"` mean **this snapshot has never been read from Figma** — it was derived from the exported types, Code Connect files and the parity audit. Treat variant names and node ids as unverified until a sync stamps them.
